_meta.rule_under_test: R2 — uncertainty_score boundary: 0 and 100 are both valid; 101+ and negative trigger FLAG
_meta.description: Four findings that probe the exact edges of R2. F-100 (score=0) and F-101 (score=100) must both PASS — they are at the inclusive boundary. F-102 (score=101) must FLAG — one step above the limit. F-103 (score=-1) must FLAG — one step below the floor. F-102 and F-103 share section 3.2.S.6, so both reach the ≥2 threshold and are promoted to ESCALATE. F-100 and F-101 share section 3.2.S.2 and both PASS, confirming no false positives at the boundary.
_meta.author: M5

findings.rationale: The synthesis step uses palladium catalyst within ICH Q3D permitted daily exposure limits for oral route.
findings.evidence_snippet: Pd residual: 8 ppm (PDE oral: 100 µg/day). Compliant with ICH Q3D.
findings.citation: ICH Q3D(R1) Guideline for Elemental Impurities, Table A.2.1

findings.rationale: The recrystallisation step uses ethyl acetate as the final wash solvent. Residual level is within ICH Q3C Class 3 limits.
findings.evidence_snippet: Ethyl acetate residual: 480 ppm (Class 3 limit: 5000 ppm). Within specification.

findings.rationale: Stability data at 40°C/75% RH for 6 months shows the drug substance is within specification.
findings.evidence_snippet: All stability parameters within limits at 6-month accelerated conditions.
findings.citation: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

findings.rationale: Long-term stability data at 25°C/60% RH shows no significant degradation over 24 months.
findings.evidence_snippet: Assay values remain above 98.5% (limit NLT 98.0%) at 24 months. Compliant.
findings.citation: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products, Section 2.2

findings.note: R2: score=0 is at the inclusive lower boundary — valid. No flags. Boundary must PASS.
R2: score=100 is at the inclusive upper boundary — valid. No flags. Boundary must PASS.
R2: score=101 is one step above the valid range [0,100]. FLAG promoted to ESCALATE — 2 FLAGs exist in section 3.2.S.6.
R2: score=-1 is one step below the valid range [0,100]. FLAG promoted to ESCALATE by the same section rule.
